name: Talnetant
summary: Talnetant (SB-223,412) is a neurokinin 3 receptor antagonist developed by GlaxoSmithKline, which is being researched for several functions. Its use as a potential antipsychotic drug for the treatment of schizophrenia has also been discontinued.

pharmacology.text: Talnetant (SB-223,412) is a neurokinin 3 receptor antagonist developed by GlaxoSmithKline, which is being researched for several functions (primarily treatment of irritable bowel syndrome, despite a 2007 study finding no statistically significant improvement in rectal hypersensitivity over placebo).

uses.text: Talnetant (SB-223,412) is a neurokinin 3 receptor antagonist developed by GlaxoSmithKline, which is being researched for several functions (primarily treatment of irritable bowel syndrome, despite a 2007 study finding no statistically significant improvement in rectal hypersensitivity over placebo). Its use as a potential antipsychotic drug for the treatment of schizophrenia has also been discontinued.

fact.en: It blocks the NK3 receptor, the target of the brain messenger neurokinin B. Later drugs that block the same receptor, such as fezolinetant, were approved to treat hot flushes during menopause.
fact.zh: Talnetant會阻斷NK3受體，也就是腦內傳訊物質神經激肽B的作用標的。後來阻斷同一受體的藥物，例如fezolinetant，已核准用於治療更年期的熱潮紅。
fact.zhHans: Talnetant会阻断NK3受体，也就是脑内传讯物质神经激肽B的作用标的。后来阻断同一受体的药物，例如fezolinetant，已核准用于治疗更年期的热潮红。
